topic: WanJuanWang GESP C++ ingestion and UI integration
summary: Implement a C++-only GESP ingestion flow for public WanJuanWang exam pages, persist question records into the existing catalog, classify programming questions into workbench domains, and add selection/judgment navigation views without breaking the current classification-first IA.
approach: Add a WanJuanWang-specific C++ GESP discovery and parsing script that outputs a replayable JSON artifact before any DB write.
Normalize parsed questions into existing catalog JSON shapes and upsert them into MySQL with review-required provenance.
Extend classification for C++ GESP questions using existing knowledge/domain seeds and explicit third-party source confidence rules.
Add filtered GESP routes and navigation entries for selection and judgment, while leaving programming questions inside the algorithm workbench flow.
Validate page counts, field completeness, and DB/API/UI visibility through dry-run and post-write checks.

confidence.pressure_pass: Highest-complexity task is parser plus normalization because upstream HTML structure and third-party provenance rules interact. Existing `problem_details` and `CatalogService` reduce model risk, but parser resilience and image handling remain the main execution pressure point.

notes: No existing standalone plan artifact was found for WanJuanWang GESP C++ ingestion.
Existing phase plans cover official ingestion, PDF parsing, OJ ingestion, classification and review, but not this third-party source feature.
C++ only. No Python, 图形化, Scratch or AtCoder-only scope is included.
Answers and analysis hidden behind login remain out of scope for scraping.
WanJuanWang classifications remain `candidate` or `needs_review` unless strengthened by trusted official evidence.
